## About
Mr. Furley's is a local bar where you can enjoy tasty cocktails, an extensive beer list, fresh hand crafted food, and a variety of games. North Hollywood is our newest spot, right on Magnolia Blvd, joining our Glendale and Sherman Oaks bars.
We keep it tavern style. There are no hosts or servers here, so you head up to the bar, order what you want and get back to your game. You're in charge of your night.
Got a birthday, work event or engagement coming up? Booking a party is free, and our private VIP Room is ready for it. We hold a 4.4 rating from 624 Google reviews.

## Services
- 50+ Craft Beers and Specialty Cocktails: An extensive beer list plus specialty cocktails. Download the NoHo drink menu from our site.
- Pool tables: Rack up a game with friends, with TVs around the room.
- Games: Pool and a variety of other games to keep the night going.
- Fresh hand crafted food: Something to eat between rounds.
- Book A Free Party: Booking is free and we can take any size group, whether it's a birthday, work event or engagement.
- Private VIP Room: Rent out the private VIP Room for your next big event.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Every day, Monday through Sunday, from 5:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

Q: Does it cost anything to book a party?
A: No. Booking is free and we can accommodate any size group. Use the book a party form to set it up or ask questions.

Q: Is there table service?
A: No. We don't have hosts or servers, so you order your drinks and food at the bar.

Q: I left my credit card or something else behind. What do I do?
A: Just come in any day after 5pm to pick it up.
